Compute adduct m/z values for molecular weights

Source: R/utils_processing.R
preprocessing_compute_adduct_weights.Rd

Calculates theoretical m/z values for different ionization adducts based on molecular weights and adduct formulas.

Usage

preprocessing_compute_adduct_weights(adduct_table, mw)

Arguments

adduct_table

Data frame with columns 'Ion_Name' (adduct names) and 'Ion_Mass' (adduct formulas as character expressions, using "PROTON" for H+).

mw

Numeric vector of molecular weights to calculate adducts for.

Value

Data frame with molecular weight in first column and calculated adduct m/z values in subsequent columns (one per adduct).
